# Extension (e): Heterogeneity of the plough effect

This file produces the single extension table of the report: models with continent fixed effects, communist history in columns (1)-(3), centred log income in columns (4)-(6), and the marginal plough effect in communist countries.

## Setup

```{r extension-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load and prepare the data

```{r extension-data}
d <- read_dta("crosscountry_dataset.dta") |>
  zap_labels() |>
  mutate(
    continent = factor(continent),
    ln_income_c = ln_income - mean(ln_income, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Control variables

The extension builds on the Table IV specification, including
historical and contemporary income controls.

```{r extension-controls}
setFixest_fml(
  ..hist = ~ agricultural_suitability + tropical_climate +
    large_animals + political_hierarchies + economic_complexity,
  ..inc = ~ ln_income + ln_income_squared
)
```

## Regressions (with continent fixed effects)

```{r extension-models}
# Plough x Communism
m_comm_fe <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * communist_dummy + ..hist + ..inc | continent,
  data = d,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

# Plough x Income (centred log income and its square replace the income controls)
m_inc_fe <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * ln_income_c + I(ln_income_c^2) + ..hist | continent,
  data = d,
  vcov = "hetero"
)
```

## Marginal plough effect in communist countries

```{r extension-marginal}
# beta1 + beta3 with its robust standard error.
# p-values use the t distribution with the model's degrees of freedom,
# exactly as fixest does for the regression coefficients.
lincom <- function(m) {
  b <- coef(m)
  V <- vcov(m)
  a <- "plow"
  i <- "plow:communist_dummy"

  est <- b[a] + b[i]
  se  <- sqrt(V[a, a] + V[i, i] + 2 * V[a, i])
  df  <- fixest::degrees_freedom(m, "t")

  c(
    estimate = unname(est),
    se       = unname(se),
    p_value  = unname(2 * pt(-abs(est / se), df))
  )
}
```

## Build the table

```{r extension-table}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.01, "***", ifelse(p < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p < 0.10, "*", "")))
}

comm_fe <- as.list(m_comm_fe)
inc_fe  <- as.list(m_inc_fe)
all_fe  <- c(comm_fe, inc_fe)

# Estimates, standard errors and p-values for one row of the table
get_row <- function(v_comm, v_inc) {
  pick <- function(m, v) coeftable(m)[v, c(1, 2, 4)]
  rbind(t(sapply(comm_fe, pick, v = v_comm)),
        t(sapply(inc_fe,  pick, v = v_inc)))
}

rows <- list(
  "Plough use (beta1)"     = get_row("plow", "plow"),
  "Z (beta2)"              = get_row("communist_dummy", "ln_income_c"),
  "Plough x Z (beta3)"     = get_row("plow:communist_dummy", "plow:ln_income_c")
)

me  <- t(sapply(comm_fe, lincom))
obs <- sapply(all_fe, nobs)
r2v <- sapply(all_fe, function(m) r2(m, "r2"))
```


```{r extension-display, echo=FALSE}
est_txt <- function(x, p) sprintf("%.3f%s", x, add_stars(p))
se_txt  <- function(x) sprintf("(%.3f)", x)

display <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(rows), function(n) {
  r <- rows[[n]]
  rbind(c(n,  est_txt(r[, 1], r[, 3])),
        c("", se_txt(r[, 2])))
}))
display <- rbind(
  display,
  c("Effect in communist countries (beta1+beta3)",
    est_txt(me[, "estimate"], me[, "p_value"]), "", "", ""),
  c("", se_txt(me[, "se"]), "", "", ""),
  c("Observations", obs),
  c("R-squared", sprintf("%.3f", r2v))
)
colnames(display) <- c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)", "(4)", "(5)", "(6)")

kbl(display, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
    caption = "Heterogeneity of the plough effect (with continent fixed effects)") |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "FLFP" = 1, "Ownership" = 1, "Politics" = 1,
                     "FLFP " = 1, "Ownership " = 1, "Politics " = 1)) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Z = communist history" = 3,
                     "Z = log income (centred)" = 3)) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "scale_down", full_width = FALSE) |>
  footnote(general = paste(
    "OLS with historical controls, income controls and continent fixed effects.",
    "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses.",
    "*** p < 0.01, ** p < 0.05, * p < 0.10."), general_title = "")
```

## Robustness check

The report states that the results are very similar without continent
fixed effects. This chunk prints the interaction coefficients without
fixed effects so this statement can be checked.

```{r extension-robustness-no-fe}
m_comm <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * communist_dummy + ..hist + ..inc,
  data = d, vcov = "hetero"
)
m_inc <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * ln_income_c + I(ln_income_c^2) + ..hist,
  data = d, vcov = "hetero"
)

etable(m_comm, keep = "plow")
etable(m_inc,  keep = "plow")
```
